fields.title: Klikindomaret record
fields.description: Raw passthrough of klikindomaret's own internal API JSON wrapped in this portfolio's dataset envelope. Upstream fields are preserved verbatim, so extra fields may appear beyond those listed here; fields prefixed with `_` are added by this actor. The `recordType` field discriminates the shape: PRODUCT (productSearch mode), CATEGORY (categoryTree), BANNER and PROMO_FILTERS (promoBanners), SUGGESTIONS (searchSuggestions), STORE (stores). Everything is store-scoped -- prices, stock and promos differ per Indomaret Xpress store.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value that produced this record: the search term, `category:<id>`, the store code, or the district ID.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: 'S1-api' for real records, 'none' on a failure/empty record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed or empty runs: BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, WAF_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED, INVALID_INPUT or EMPTY_RESULT.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PRODUCT, CATEGORY, BANNER, PROMO_FILTERS, SUGGESTIONS or STORE -- tells you which field set this row carries.

_query.title: Query
_query.description: productSearch mode. The keyword or category label that produced this product record.

_categoryPath.title: Category path
_categoryPath.description: categoryTree mode. Breadcrumb path of this node, e.g. 'Produk Supermarket > Susu & Olahannya'.

_childCount.title: Child count
_childCount.description: categoryTree mode. Number of immediate sub-categories under this node.

plu.title: PLU
plu.description: PRODUCT. Indomaret article/PLU code -- the stable SKU used across stores and on in-store receipts.

parentProductId.title: Parent product ID
parentProductId.description: PRODUCT. Parent id for variant products, 0 for standalone products.

productName.title: Product name
productName.description: PRODUCT. Display name of the product.

permalink.title: Permalink
permalink.description: PRODUCT / CATEGORY. URL slug on klikindomaret.com.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: PRODUCT / CATEGORY / BANNER. Full-size image on the klikindomaret CDN.

images.title: Images
images.description: PRODUCT. Additional image URLs (often empty in listings).

finalPrice.title: Final price (IDR)
finalPrice.description: PRODUCT. Price actually charged after discount, in rupiah.

bulkPrice.title: Bulk list price (IDR)
bulkPrice.description: PRODUCT. Pre-discount price of the bulk/multi-pack unit, when the product has one.

discountValue.title: Discount value (IDR)
discountValue.description: PRODUCT. Absolute discount amount in rupiah.

discountText.title: Discount text
discountText.description: PRODUCT. Discount as advertised on the card, e.g. '50%'.

isVariant.title: Is variant
isVariant.description: PRODUCT. True when the product is one variant of a parent product.

promo.title: Promo
promo.description: PRODUCT. Raw promo object attached to the product, when any.

promoType.title: Promo type
promoType.description: PRODUCT. Promo mechanism code (discount, gift, bundle, ...).

promoText.title: Promo text
promoText.description: PRODUCT. Promo label shown on the product card.

promoTagList.title: Promo tags
promoTagList.description: PRODUCT. Promo tags/badges applied to the product.

listPromoDisplay.title: Promo display list
listPromoDisplay.description: PRODUCT. Promo badges as rendered on the listing card.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: PRODUCT. Marketing badge object (e.g. new, best seller).

bulkQty.title: Bulk quantity
bulkQty.description: PRODUCT. Units per bulk pack, 0 when not sold in bulk.

minStrukQty.title: Min receipt quantity
minStrukQty.description: PRODUCT. Minimum quantity per receipt (struk) for promo-limited items.

maxStrukQty.title: Max receipt quantity
maxStrukQty.description: PRODUCT. Purchase cap per receipt (struk) -- the usual promo quantity limit.

availableQtyStruk.title: Available receipt quantity
availableQtyStruk.description: PRODUCT. Remaining quantity buyable on this receipt under the promo cap.

descriptionList.title: Description blocks
descriptionList.description: PRODUCT. List of {title, content} description sections from the product detail.

productSource.title: Product source
productSource.description: PRODUCT. Where stock is served from, e.g. 'warehouse' or 'store'.

size.title: Size
size.description: PRODUCT. Pack size as printed, e.g. '80g'.

flavour.title: Flavour
flavour.description: PRODUCT. Flavour/variant attribute, when the catalog carries one.

bulkUom.title: Bulk unit of measure
bulkUom.description: PRODUCT. Selling unit of the bulk pack.

blacklist.title: Blacklisted
blacklist.description: PRODUCT. True when the item is blocked from sale in this context.

selling.title: Selling
selling.description: PRODUCT. True when the item is currently sellable at this store -- the closest thing to a stock flag.

storeMatchFlag.title: Store match flag
storeMatchFlag.description: PRODUCT. Whether the item matched the resolved store's assortment.

packagePlu.title: Package PLU
packagePlu.description: PRODUCT. PLU of the bundling package, when the item is sold as part of one.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: PRODUCT. Raw package/bundle object (package PLU, quantities).

pairProducts.title: Paired products
pairProducts.description: PRODUCT. Products bundled with or suggested alongside this one.

id.title: ID
id.description: CATEGORY / BANNER. Node or banner identifier. Category ids can be fed straight back into the actor's Category IDs input.

level.title: Level
level.description: CATEGORY. Depth in the tree (1 = top-level meta category).

position.title: Position
position.description: CATEGORY. Display order among its siblings.

hasRestricted.title: Has restricted
hasRestricted.description: CATEGORY. True when the branch contains age/regulation-restricted products.

hasBlacklisted.title: Has blacklisted
hasBlacklisted.description: CATEGORY. True when the branch contains blacklisted products.

subCategories.title: Sub-categories
subCategories.description: CATEGORY. Raw sub-category payload on nodes that use this key instead of `categories`; children are also emitted as their own rows.

url.title: URL
url.description: BANNER. Target deep link (klikindomaret:// app scheme).

webUrl.title: Web URL
webUrl.description: BANNER. Target link used on the web front-end.

webView.title: Web view
webView.description: BANNER. Whether the target opens in an in-app web view.

type.title: Type
type.description: BANNER. Channel the banner belongs to, e.g. 'xpress'.

status.title: Status
status.description: BANNER. Publication status of the banner.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: BANNER. ISO 8601 start of the promo period.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: BANNER. ISO 8601 end of the promo period -- how long the campaign still runs.

promoKindId.title: Promo kind ID
promoKindId.description: BANNER. Promo mechanism id; joins to promoTypeOptions in the PROMO_FILTERS record.

productPageCode.title: Product page code
productPageCode.description: BANNER. Slug of the promo product page the banner points to.

promoTypeOptions.title: Promo type options
promoTypeOptions.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Every promo mechanism currently running, as {promoId, promoName, parentId, hasChild}.

promoTypeSubFilterOptions.title: Promo sub-filter options
promoTypeSubFilterOptions.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Sub-filters available under the selected promo type.

metaCategoryOptions.title: Meta category options
metaCategoryOptions.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Top-level categories usable as promo filters.

selectedMetaCategoryId.title: Selected meta category ID
selectedMetaCategoryId.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Meta category the listing was filtered by (0 = none).

selectedPromoTypeId.title: Selected promo type ID
selectedPromoTypeId.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Promo type the listing was filtered by (0 = none).

selectedPromoTypeIds.title: Selected promo type IDs
selectedPromoTypeIds.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Promo types applied to the request.

selectedPromoTypeSubFilterIds.title: Selected promo sub-filter IDs
selectedPromoTypeSubFilterIds.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Promo sub-filters applied to the request.

selectAll.title: Select all
selectAll.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Whether the 'all promos' filter was active.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: PROMO_FILTERS. Sort order the banner list was returned in, e.g. 'period,asc'.

popularKeywords.title: Popular keywords
popularKeywords.description: SUGGESTIONS. Trending search keywords -- useful seeds for a productSearch run.

categoryRecommendation.title: Category recommendations
categoryRecommendation.description: SUGGESTIONS. Recommended categories with ids, names and permalinks.

lastSeen.title: Last seen
lastSeen.description: SUGGESTIONS. Recently viewed items (empty for anonymous sessions).

lastSearch.title: Last search
lastSearch.description: SUGGESTIONS. Recent searches (empty for anonymous sessions).

storeCode.title: Store code
storeCode.description: STORE. Indomaret Xpress store code serving the district, e.g. 'TJKT'. Feed it back as the actor's Store code input.

areaCoverageId.title: Area coverage ID
areaCoverageId.description: STORE. Internal coverage-area id for the district.

clusterGroupCode.title: Cluster group code
clusterGroupCode.description: STORE. Cluster group the store belongs to.

storeList.title: Store list
storeList.description: STORE. Additional stores covering the district, when the API returns more than one.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: STORE. Store latitude -- reusable as the actor's Latitude input.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: STORE. Store longitude -- reusable as the actor's Longitude input.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type -- rows render blank for columns that do not apply to their shape.

products.title: Products
products.description: Pricing and promo columns for productSearch runs.

categories.title: Category tree
categories.description: Flattened category hierarchy from categoryTree runs.

promos.title: Promo banners
promos.description: Running campaigns and their periods from promoBanners runs.
